mentions.name: My Vocab Quest
mentions.description: This iOS vocabulary mastery app offers many word packs and uses gamification mechanics to keep users putting in the practice reps.
mentions.source_excerpt: Most recently released one was My Vocab Quest[1], a vocab mastery app with lots of word packs. It uses some gamification mechanics to make sure the user puts in the reps.
